fields.label: Product Name
fields.description: Name and function of the cosmetic product.
fields.fix: Print the product name and its function on the front panel.

fields.label: INCI Ingredient List
fields.fix: List ingredients using INCI names in descending order of concentration.

fields.label: Net Quantity
fields.fix: State net content in metric units (e.g. 100 ml).

fields.label: Expiry / PAO
fields.fix: Add an expiry date or a period-after-opening marking (e.g. 12M).

fields.label: Responsible Person
fields.description: Name and address of the manufacturer or responsible person.
fields.fix: Include the name and address of the manufacturer or responsible person.

fields.label: Batch Number
fields.fix: Print a batch code on the container and the outer packaging.

fields.label: Warnings & Precautions
fields.fix: Add required safety warnings, e.g. 'For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.'

fields.label: Directions for Use
fields.fix: Add directions for use where the intended use is not obvious.

fields.label: Country of Origin
fields.description: Country where the product was made.
fields.fix: Add a country of origin statement.
